description: Fork of exp737 v2 (LUT bs=48 4K bf16 storage + fp32 master Lion + force-bmm, val=1.3872 @ 276.8M). Two surgical autocast(bf16) wraps inside model.forward: (1) F.scaled_dot_product_attention call → bf16 SDPA, attn cast back to fp32 for out_proj input; (2) self.unembedder(x_resid) → bf16 head matmul. Both wraps live inside forward so they cover train AND eval automatically. LayerNorms/residual adds untouched at fp32. LUT modules unchanged (already bf16 via use_bf16=True). Matches exp738's bf16-everywhere train forward pattern. Goal: validate the bf16-everywhere pattern is free for LUT-LM, matching the vanilla exp738 vs exp739 Δ≈0 finding.
